title: Louisiana Property Condition Disclosure
description: La. R.S. 9:3198 requires sellers of residential real property to provide a written property disclosure document to prospective buyers. The disclosure must cover structural components, mechanical systems, water intrusion, environmental hazards, and known defects. This applies to 1-4 unit residential properties.

required_actions.note: Exemptions include transfers between co-owners, foreclosure sales, and transfers by fiduciaries.

title: Agency Disclosure
description: Louisiana License Law (La. R.S. 37:1455.1) requires real estate licensees to make a written disclosure of their agency status to all parties at the first substantive contact. Dual agency requires informed written consent from all parties.

title: Community Property State — Spousal Consent
description: Louisiana is a community property state. Both spouses must sign the act of sale (deed) to convey community property. La. C.C. Art. 2347 requires the concurrence of both spouses for alienation of community property. Failure to obtain spousal consent may render the transaction voidable.

required_actions.note: Both spouses must sign the act of sale (deed). Verify community vs. separate property status.
Check for matrimonial agreements that may modify the community property regime.

title: Closing Type — Notary Required
description: Louisiana closings are conducted by notaries public. Louisiana civil law requires that acts of sale (deeds) for immovable property be executed in authentic form before a notary and two witnesses. In Louisiana, notaries have broader authority than in common law states; many are also attorneys.

required_actions.note: Must be executed before a Louisiana notary public and two competent witnesses.

title: Flood Zone and Elevation Disclosure
description: Given Louisiana's significant flood risk, La. R.S. 9:3198.5 requires sellers to disclose known flooding history, whether the property is in a FEMA-designated flood zone, current flood insurance status, and elevation certificate availability. This is a critical disclosure given Louisiana's geography.

required_actions.note: Included in Louisiana Property Disclosure Document. Disclose flood zone, flood history, insurance status, and elevation certificate.
